leaders.name: Leaders
leaders.rule: Hold the 20 strongest stocks by 12-month strength (price a month ago against a year ago) among the 350 most traded. Checked after the first session of each week.
leaders.exit: Sell at the next open when a holding is no longer in the top 20% by strength, or is no longer among the 500 most traded. No stop: every stop tested made this book worse.
leaders.size: One twentieth of the book in each stock.

swing.name: Leader pullback
swing.rule: A stock in the top 30% by 12-month strength, above its 200-day average with the 50-day above the 200-day, falls 3 ATR or more in 5 sessions.
swing.exit: Sell at the next open after a close above the 5-day average, or after 7 sessions. Stop 3 ATR below the entry.
swing.size: Risk a fixed part of capital between entry and stop.

index.name: NIFTY 50
index.rule: The index is above its 200-day average and has fallen 2.5% or more in 5 sessions.
index.exit: Sell at the next open after a close above the 5-day average, or after 7 sessions. No stop was tested: use a spread or small size.
index.size: Futures, or a call spread that risks only its cost.

rejected.name: 52-week-high breakout
rejected.rule: First close above the 252-session high, in an uptrend. Trail 3.5 ATR, out below the 50-day average.

rejected.name: Delivery accumulation near highs
rejected.rule: Ten-day delivered quantity at twice normal, within 10% of the 52-week high. Same exits.

rejected.name: Heavy-volume surge day
rejected.rule: Up 5% or more on three times normal volume, closing in the top third of the day. Hold 40 sessions, stop 3 ATR.
